action ok: 
login POST: 000 -> 
after-login redirect:

observation.command:
cd /tmp
CSRF=$(grep -oE 'name="csrf"[^>]*value="[^"]+"' kc.html | grep -oE 'value="[^"]+"' | sed 's/value="//;s/"//')
echo "csrf len: ${#CSRF}"
ACTION=$(grep -oE '<form[^>]*id="kc-login"[^>]*action="[^"]+"' kc.html | grep -oE 'action="[^"]+"' | sed 's/action="//;s/"//;s/&/\&/g')
echo "action ok: $(echo "$ACTION" | head -c 80)"
# Step 3: POST login
curl -s -b cj.txt -c cj.txt -o after.html -w 'login POST: %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n' \
  -d "csrf=$CSRF&username=spark@example.com&password=SparkLocalPassw0rd!" \
  --data-urlencode "csrf=$CSRF" "$ACTION" \
  -d "username=spark@example.com" -d "password=SparkLocalPassw0rd!"
# Step 4: follow the authz redirect to get code
FINAL=$(curl -s -b cj.txt -c cj.txt -o /dev/null -w '%{redirect_url}' "$ACTION" 2>/dev/null)
echo "after-login redirect: $(echo "$FINAL" | head -c 200)"
